description: Read the oldest unacknowledged events of an event queue, oldest first. Each event is the same envelope a webhook delivery carries (version, event_id, event_type, created_at, test, data). Reading changes nothing: handle the events, then acknowledge their event_id values, and read again while has_more is true. Delivery is at least once, so skip event_id values already handled. Events not acknowledged within 30 days are deleted.

limit.description: How many of the oldest unacknowledged events to return, 1-100. Default 50.

name: shipmail_list_event_queue_events

event_id.description: Unique per event. Dedupe on it and pass it to ack.

title: List Event Queue Events
